label: Click stream (cursor through web content, event chips)
description: A hand working through the internet -- a relay piece (the Quotient Analytics film). Web content RUSHES past (a strip of pieces sliding sideways while the camera pulls back and pushes in; the strip bunches as it pulls back, so the rush is dense; nothing fades or blurs) and STOPS on a piece, centred in `region` at a readable size (k = min(fit_w x region width / w, fit_h x region height / h): landing pages ~90% of the width, tall pieces ~85% of the height) on clean canvas with a soft shadow. The built-in cursor glides to the stop's `target` (image pixels [x,y,w,h]) and clicks it (0.12 s press + ring; the target flashes a purple press ring), and the click throws a purple EVENT CHIP (white Geist 600, a pill with a dot) that springs out of the click point, flies an arc and lands -- centred, shrunk to chip_land_scale -- EXACTLY at `chip_to` at its land time, then vanishes (the film's activity feed takes over there as a new row). Five to seven stops, each faster than the last. SCHEDULE (scene seconds, published on the root as data-click-times / data-land-times / data-arrive-times / data-leave-times, ms precision): with N stops, hold_i = first_hold x (last_hold/first_hold)^(i/(N-1)); travel_i (the rush INTO stop i, i>=1) = travel x (last_travel/travel)^((i-1)/(N-2)) (N=2: travel); arrive_0 = at + enter; arrive_i = leave_{i-1} + travel_i; click_i = arrive_i + click_at x hold_i; leave_i = arrive_i + hold_i; land_i = click_i + chip_pop + chip_travel. Defaults (6 stops, at 0): clicks 1.05, 2.41, 3.58, 4.58, 5.44, 6.19; lands +0.6. `times` [...] overrides the click moments (each stop then sits round its click with the formula's hold; land = time + chip_pop + chip_travel); `grid` quantizes computed clicks to a music grid. END: end_mode "hold" keeps the last stop where it landed; "zoom" grows it at zoom_at (default leave of the last stop) over zoom_duration (0.5 s, power3.inOut) to COVER the region (k = max(region w / w, region h / h), object-fit cover) with the target pulled as close to the region centre as the cover allows (zoom_focus "target"; "center" centres the image), then FROZEN to the scene end with the cursor resting on the target. data-last-target="cx,cy,w,h" is the last target's box after it settles, in fractions of the component box: hold: left = RX + RW/2 - w k/2, top = RY + RH/2 - h k/2 with k = min(fit_w RW/w, fit_h RH/h); zoom: k = max(RW/w, RH/h), left = RX + clamp(RW/2 - (tx + tw/2) k, RW - w k, 0), top = RY + clamp(RH/2 - (ty + th/2) k, RH - h k, 0); then cx = (left + (tx + tw/2) k)/W, cy = (top + (ty + th/2) k)/H, w = tw k/W, h = th k/H (RX..RH = region in box px, W x H = the component box; a full-frame slot is the camera layer, 40 px larger than the frame, so fractions are of that box, as with every other piece). data-settle-time is when it stops moving. Example: {"region":{"x":0,"y":0,"w":0.62,"h":1},"at":0.25,"chip_to":[0.8,0.3],"stream":[{"src":"/assets/c03.jpg","w":1080,"h":1350},{"src":"/assets/c07.jpg","w":1080,"h":1350}],"stops":[{"src":"/assets/c01.jpg","w":1080,"h":1350,"target":[64,1144,364,90],"chip":"Clicked · Try Flows free — Kestrel","kind":"email"},{"src":"/assets/northwind-full.png","w":1920,"h":1080,"target":[552,812,360,92],"chip":"Clicked · See the report — Northwind","kind":"email"}],"end_mode":"zoom"}.

stops.label: The pieces it stops on, in order (1-12; 5-7 reads best): {src, w, h (image pixels), target: [x, y, w, h] (PIXELS of that image: the thing clicked), chip: event text (e.g. "Clicked · Pricing — Northwind"), kind?: email|landing|social|ad|blog (names the default chip verb)}

stream.label: Background pieces that rush past between stops, {src, w, h}; reused in order (give 12-30)

region.label: Where the stream plays inside the box, fractions {x, y, w, h} (default the whole box; the film uses {x:0,y:0,w:0.62,h:1} with the feed on the right). Pieces are clipped to it; chips and the cursor are not

at.label: When the strip starts sliding in from the region's right edge (s, default 0)

enter.label: Seconds from `at` until the first stop has landed (default 0.5)

first_hold.label: How long the first stop sits (s, default 1.1)

last_hold.label: How long the last stop sits before the end/zoom (s, default 0.45); holds between are geometric

travel.label: The rush into the second stop (s, default 0.35)

last_travel.label: The rush into the last stop (s, default 0.25); geometric between

click_at.label: Where in each hold the click lands, 0-1 (default 0.5)

times.label: Explicit click moments (s), one per stop -- overrides the formula

grid.label: Quantize computed click moments to this grid (s, e.g. 0.25); omit for the exact formula

chip_to.label: Where every chip lands (its centre), fractions of the box [x, y] (default [0.8, 0.3])

chip_pop.label: Seconds the chip springs out of the click point (default 0.15)

chip_travel.label: Seconds the chip flies to chip_to (default 0.45)

chip_hold.label: Seconds the chip stays at chip_to after landing (default 0: gone as it lands)

chip_size.label: Chip font size, fraction of the box width (default 0.0105)

chip_arc.label: How high the chip's flight arcs, fraction of the box height (default 0.12)

chip_land_scale.label: The chip's scale as it lands (default 0.88)

end_mode.label: After the last stop: hold (it stays) | zoom (it grows to cover the region, then freezes)

zoom_at.label: zoom: when the last stop starts growing (default: its leave time)

zoom_focus.label: zoom: target (pull the target toward the region centre, default) | center

fit_w.label: A stop's resting width cap, fraction of the region width (default 0.9)

fit_h.label: A stop's resting height cap, fraction of the region height (default 0.85)

rush_scale.label: How far the camera pulls back mid-rush (scale, default 0.5)

background.label: Region fill (default none: the scene's canvas, #efeeea in the film)

clip.label: Clip the pieces to the region (default true)

seed.label: Changes the stream pieces' sizes, tilts and offsets (same seed, same stream)

cursor_from.label: Where the cursor starts at `at` [x, y] (fractions of the box; default low right of the region) -- the previous piece's cursor_to

cursor_to.label: Where the cursor goes after the last click [x, y] (omit: it rests on the last target, riding the zoom)

cursor_to_at.label: When it leaves for cursor_to (default: the zoom end, or last click + 0.3)

cursor_exit_at.label: When the cursor vanishes (omit to keep it)

cursor_size.label: Cursor size, a fraction of the box width (default 0.027)
